itemListElement.name: Fractional Chief AI Officer for mid-market and enterprise teams

mainEntity.name: How much does a fractional Chief AI Officer cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Market retainers generally run from about $3,000 to more than $30,000 a month (Christian & Timbers, 2026). My engagements are scoped to your situation, and the intro call gives you a realistic shape and range.

mainEntity.name: How much time does a fractional CAIO commit?

acceptedAnswer.text: The commitment is set as a monthly rhythm agreed on the intro call, based on your size, risk profile and number of active initiatives, rather than billed task by task.

mainEntity.name: Can you help us hire a permanent Chief AI Officer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A common pattern is to use a fractional leader to set governance and scope the permanent role, then start the permanent search while they are still in place.

mainEntity.name: Do you replace our CIO or CTO?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. A fractional Chief AI Officer works alongside them, owning AI strategy, governance and vendor decisions while technology leaders keep running infrastructure and delivery.
